notes: Breadboard coordinates read from the image: the button straddles the centre gap with legs in columns 4 and 6 (4t.e, 4b.f, 6t.e, 6b.f).
The two legs in column 4 are treated as side 1 (joined inside the button) and the two in column 6 as side 2. Pressing the button joins the GND column to the pin-2 column.
The blue wire goes from D2 to hole 6b.i, in the same strip as the button's column-6 legs. The black wire goes from the GND header next to 5V (GND.1) to 4t.c, in the same strip as the column-4 legs.
There is no external pull-up resistor. The sketch uses INPUT_PULLUP.
The diagram shows a Leonardo-style board, so arduino-leonardo is used. The GND pin labelled in the diagram is mapped to GND.1.
